question_text: 40 out of the 50 video games at Gaming Paradise are RPG games. What percentage of the video games at Gaming Paradise are RPG games? Write your answer using a percent sign (%).=_
solution: To find what percentage of video games are RPG games, first divide the number of RPG games by the total number of video games: $\frac{40}{50} = 0.8

Therefore, 80% of the video games at Gaming Paradise are RPG games.
